content.comment_body: Hello, is there a module that can process wireless signals from Enocean switches to control them using a [product_name] controller?
Hi [user_name], There is currently no communication module available for Enocean integration with [product_name] controllers.

Sorry, I accidentally sent this answer to the moderator earlier. There is a gateway called Enocean-EIB-Gateway from Schlaps&Partner, which needs to be integrated into an EIB network. To achieve this, you would use a [product_name] controller with an EIB module. While I don't own one myself, I have seen the system operating successfully.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to connect wireless Enocean switches to [product_name] controllers, but discovers there is no direct communication module for this purpose. Information is shared about a third-party Enocean-EIB-Gateway and the necessary EIB network and [product_name] EIB module, suggesting that integration is feasible but requires additional external hardware and setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a simple integration solution that enables direct connection between Enocean switches and [product_name] controllers for control tasks.
